subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Problematizar hábitos e práticas individuais e coletivos de produção, reaproveitamento e descarte de resíduos em metrópoles, áreas urbanas e rurais, e comunidades com diferentes características socioeconômicas, e elaborar e/ou selecionar propostas de ação que promovam a sustentabilidade socioambiental, o combate à poluição sistêmica e o consumo responsável.

components.description_pt: Examinar hábitos de produção, reutilização e descarte de resíduos em contextos metropolitanos, urbanos, rurais e socioeconômicos diversos
components.description_en: Examine waste production, reuse, and disposal habits in metropolitan, urban, rural, and diverse socioeconomic contexts
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a technological solution based on its potential to minimize waste and ecosystem degradation

components.description_pt: Comparar práticas de gestão de resíduos entre comunidades com características socioeconômicas variadas
components.description_en: Compare waste management practices across communities with varying socioeconomic characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a technological solution based on its potential to minimize waste and ecosystem degradation

components.description_pt: Analisar a relação entre hábitos individuais e coletivos e a poluição sistêmica
components.description_en: Analyze the relationship between individual and collective habits and systemic pollution
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between human population growth and increased consumption of natural resources

components.description_pt: Desenvolver ou selecionar propostas de ação que promovam sustentabilidade socioambiental e consumo responsável
components.description_en: Develop or select action proposals that promote socio-environmental sustainability and responsible consumption
components.cc_component_description: Construct an evidence-based argument linking human population and consumption trends to environmental change

cc_matches.description: Scientists and engineers can make major contributions by developing technologies that produce less pollution and waste and that preclude ecosystem degradation.
Typically as human populations and per-capita consumption of natural resources increase, so do the negative impacts on Earth unless the activities and technologies involved are engineered otherwise.
Construct an argument supported by evidence for how increases in human population and per-capita consumption of natural resources impact Earth's systems.
